cards.name: Moltres

cards.flavorText: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

cards.name: Fennekin

attacks.name: Tail Whip
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

cards.name: Seel
cards.flavorText: Covered with light blue fur, its hide is thick and tough. It is active in bitter cold of -40 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Dewgong

rules: Put this card onto your Bench only with the effect of Helix Fossil Omanyte
cards.flavorText: Revived from an ancient fossil, this Pokémon uses air stored in its shell to sink and rise in water.

cards.name: Omastar

abilities.name: Restoring Beam

cards.flavorText: Once wrapped around its prey, it never lets go. It eats the prey by tearing at it with sharp fangs.

cards.name: White Kyurem

attacks.name: Burning Icicles

attacks.name: Blizzard Burn
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: Rotom

attacks.text: Search your deck for a basic Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Spoink

attacks.name: Rocket Jump

cards.flavorText: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.

cards.name: Solosis

attacks.name: Mini Link

cards.flavorText: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

cards.name: Duosion

attacks.name: Double Link

cards.flavorText: When their two divided brains think the same thoughts, their psychic power is maximized.

cards.name: Diglett
